mapper.select: /* Tbm01Mapper.selectTbmEduItemInfo */ SELECT '' AS chk , A.MTRL_ITEM_CD AS mtrlItemCd , A.MTRL_CD AS mtrlCd , A.SORT_IDX AS sortIdx , A.MTRL_ITEM_TYPE AS mtrlItemType , A.MTRL_DESC AS mtrlDesc , A.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd , B.FILE_NM AS fileNm , B.FILE_PATH AS filePath , B.FILE_EXT AS fileExt , A.URL AS url , A.USE_YN AS useYn , A.THUMB_FILE_MGMT_CD AS thumbFileMgmtCd , A.DURATION_SEC AS durationSec /* 데이터 초기화 값 */ , A.SORT_IDX AS oriSortIdx , A.MTRL_ITEM_TYPE AS oriMtrlItemType , A.MTRL_DESC AS oriMtrlDesc , A.FILE_MGMT_CD AS oriFileMgmtCd , B.FILE_NM AS oriFileNm , B.FILE_PATH AS oriFilePath , B.FILE_EXT AS oriFileExt , A.URL AS oriUrl , A.USE_YN AS oriUseYn FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM A INNER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M ON ( A.MTRL_CD = M.MTRL_CD AND M.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_FILE_INFO B ON ( A.FILE_MGMT_CD = B.FILE_MGMT_CD ) WHERE A.MTRL_CD = #{mtrlCd} ORDER BY A.SORT_IDX

/* Tbm01Mapper.selectTbmEduDetail */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.MTRL_CD AS mtrlCd , A.TITLE AS title , A.CONTENTS AS contents , A.MTRL_TYPE AS mtrlType , A.USE_YN AS useYn , ( SELECT COUNT(I.MTRL_ITEM_CD) FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM I WHERE I.MTRL_CD = A.MTRL_CD AND I.USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS mtrlCnt , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , CASE WHEN A.SITE_CD IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS isCommonContent , A.TITLE AS oriTitle , A.CONTENTS AS oriContents , A.MTRL_TYPE AS oriMtrlType , A.USE_YN AS oriUseYn , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.INSERT_NO, NULL) AS insertNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.MTRL_CD = #{mtrlCd}

/* Tbm01Mapper.selectTbmEduDetailItems */ SELECT '' AS chk , A.MTRL_ITEM_CD AS mtrlItemCd , A.MTRL_CD AS mtrlCd , A.SORT_IDX AS sortIdx , A.MTRL_ITEM_TYPE AS mtrlItemType , A.MTRL_DESC AS mtrlDesc , A.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd , B.FILE_NM AS fileNm , B.FILE_PATH AS filePath , B.FILE_EXT AS fileExt , A.URL AS url , A.USE_YN AS useYn , A.THUMB_FILE_MGMT_CD AS thumbFileMgmtCd , A.DURATION_SEC AS durationSec /* record 시그니처 맞춤용(상세 화면 미사용) */ , A.SORT_IDX AS oriSortIdx , A.MTRL_ITEM_TYPE AS oriMtrlItemType , A.MTRL_DESC AS oriMtrlDesc , A.FILE_MGMT_CD AS oriFileMgmtCd , B.FILE_NM AS oriFileNm , B.FILE_PATH AS oriFilePath , B.FILE_EXT AS oriFileExt , A.URL AS oriUrl , A.USE_YN AS oriUseYn FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM A INNER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M ON ( A.MTRL_CD = M.MTRL_CD AND M.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_FILE_INFO B ON ( A.FILE_MGMT_CD = B.FILE_MGMT_CD ) WHERE A.MTRL_CD = #{mtrlCd} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.SORT_IDX

/* Tbm01Mapper.selectTbmEduUsedSessions */ SELECT S.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , S.TITLE AS title , S.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , S.SITE_CD AS siteCd , DATE_FORMAT(S.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt , DATE_FORMAT(S.ENDED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endedAt , SC.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_CONTENT SC INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON ( SC.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND SC.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD ) WHERE SC.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND SC.MTRL_CD = #{mtrlCd} AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY S.INSERT_DATE DESC
